chunks: And the Truthful One (Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq) (peace be upon him) said:

When Musa (peace be upon him) performed Hajj, Jibril (peace be upon him) descended upon him. Musa said to him: 'O Jibril, what is the reward for one who performs Hajj to this House without a sincere intention and without lawful provisions?' He said: 'I do not know until I return to my Lord, the Mighty and Majestic.'

When he returned, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: 'O Jibril, what did Musa say to you?'—though He already knows what he said. He said: 'O my Lord, he asked me about the one who performs Hajj to this House without a sincere intention and without lawful provisions.'
Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: 'Return to him and tell him: I grant him My right and seek the satisfaction of My creation concerning him.'
Then Musa said: 'O Jibril, what about the one who performs Hajj to this House with a sincere intention and lawful provisions?'

He said, so he returned to Allah, the Exalted, and Allah revealed to him: 'Tell him: I will place him in the highest company with “the Prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous—what excellent companions they are.”'

key_terms.الرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى: the highest company (of prophets and righteous)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference in reward for Hajj performed with sincere intention versus without it?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (as) narrates that when Prophet Musa (as) performed Hajj, he asked Archangel Jibril (as) about the reward for performing Hajj with and without sincere intention and lawful provisions. Jibril consulted Allah, who revealed that those with sincere intention and lawful provisions are granted His right and satisfaction, and are placed in the highest company with the Prophets, truthful, martyrs, and righteous.
